## Instructor Co-host Add-on (optional)

Adds internal instructors as **co-organisers** of the Teams meeting created by the main workflow.

- Trigger is **Event Updated**. Administrate has no webhook for staff changes, so after adding an instructor, edit and save the Event to fire it.
- Only continues when the virtual classroom is already configured (`remoteMeeting.type == msteams`).
- Reads staff with the role named `INSTRUCTOR_STAFF_ROLE_NAME` and splits them into internal (email domain in `INTERNAL_DOMAINS`) and external. External instructors are logged and skipped because they have no identity in your Microsoft tenant.
- For each internal instructor it looks up their Microsoft Graph user ID, reads the meeting's current attendees (the PATCH replaces the whole list, so existing attendees are kept), adds the instructors with `role: coorganizer` and PATCHes the meeting.
- `ORGANISER_MAILBOX_ID` is the Microsoft Entra object ID of the account that owns the meetings (the host contact from the main workflow).

**Known limitations:**
- Every save re-runs the PATCH for all current instructors, not only new ones. This is harmless because the PATCH sets the same role again.
- Needs a Microsoft Graph app-only credential with `OnlineMeetings.ReadWrite.All` and an application access policy. Attach it to the three HTTP Request nodes after import.

parameters.name: Instructor Co-host - Event Updated
